app.title: Making Atuin sync 32x faster with packfiles
app.description: An open‑source shell history manager that syncs across machines using efficient packfile compression.
proposed_tests: Install atuin via cargo and run `atuin sync` on two machines
Verify that history entries are correctly compressed and decompressed
Measure sync time for 10,000 entries before and after packfile optimization
Check integrity of history after sync with `atuin list`
